title: Community
description: EWDS Topic schema for Client Gateway payload validation. Represents an INTELLIGENT energy community (int:Community). Closest CIM parent is cim:EnergyArea.

communityId.description: Primary unique identifier for the energy community. RFC 4122 UUID v4.

communityName.description: Human-readable name of the energy community.

communityType.description: Legal organisational type per EU energy community legislation (EU Directive 2018/2001 RED II and 2019/944).

legalStructure.description: Official legal structure of the community, e.g. ZEV (LIC/CELL Switzerland), CSC scheme (Greenvolt Portugal), RSC collective (Aran Islands Ireland).

communityOperatorId.description: FK to the Actor who acts as community manager/operator. Contact and legal details are on the Actor record.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the community location.

latitude.description: Anonymised representative latitude coordinate, decimal degrees, per D2.1 GDPR guidance.

longitude.description: Anonymised representative longitude coordinate, decimal degrees, per D2.1 GDPR guidance.

gridConnectionVoltageLevel.description: Nominal voltage at which the community connects to the distribution grid, in V. IEC CIM VoltageLevel. E.g. 400 V (LV), 20000 V (MV).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for billing and trading within this community.

marketMechanism.description: Type of energy sharing or trading mechanism permitted, e.g. P2P trading, collective self-consumption, virtual net metering.

co2EmissionFactor.description: Grid CO2 emission factor for this community grid mix, in gCO2/kWh.

yearEstablished.description: Year the community was formally established.

validFrom.description: Start of the community-site association. ISO 8601 with timezone.

validUntil.description: End of the association, ISO 8601 with timezone. Populated when a community leaves a site.

operationalRole.description: Role of this community at this site. Primary = main operating community. Secondary = co-existing community. Virtual = virtual trading only, no physical presence.
